title: Publication and idempotency
summary: Publication requests bind brand, account, surface, approved content revision, intention, narrative and approval; fingerprint collision fails instead of overwriting recorded receipts.
invariants: Duplicate request/fingerprint returns the existing receipt; modified payload using the same key fails.
A provider acknowledgement is not verified delivery, and published content is not evidence of brand effect.
